messages:
Sam: FYI saw a customer report where reconnecting mid-stream led to what looks like duplicate token charges. repro below.
Sam: repro steps: start streaming -> send ~120 tokens -> transient network hiccup -> client reconnects -> server resumes but trims a few prefix tokens -> billing shows both sessions charged for the same tokens.
Maria: can you paste a log / session ids?
Sam: log snippet:```
[2026-03-19T12:03:41Z] session=abc123 provisional_tokens=120
[2026-03-19T12:03:44Z] network: client disconnected (timeout)
[2026-03-19T12:03:45Z] session=def456 resumed_from=abc123 trimmed_prefix=8 provisional_tokens=8
[2026-03-19T12:03:46Z] billing: charge session=abc123 tokens=120 status=provisional
[2026-03-19T12:03:47Z] billing: charge session=def456 tokens=8 status=confirmed
```
Ajay: interesting — looks like two mechanisms: provisional provisionalization for in-flight stream and then confirm on resume. If resume creates a new session id (def456) we end up charging trimmed tokens again because our dedupe key is session id + prefix.
Kai: we do have dedupe for toolcall idempotency but streams are keyed differently. The trimmed_prefix case is tricky because the runtime removes leading KV cache entries to reclaim memory, and the billing layer only sees the resumed session as a separate request.
Maria: console telemetry currently surfaces provisional vs confirmed but doesn't show resume_session_id or trimmed_prefix anywhere. ops can't easily link the provisional charge to the later confirmed one.
Sam: customer-facing: they saw two charges in UI and assumed double-billing. We refunded but need fix.
Ajay: short term mitigation: treat provisional charges as provisional in billing UI and suppress showing them as billable until confirmation, with a tooltip explaining provisional credits. That avoids confusing customers while we fix backend dedupe.
Kai: agree but metrics and dashboards for SLOs will be affected unless we add link fields. We should also add resume_session_id and parent_session_id to billing traces so the ledger can correlate.
Maria: proposal: (1) add resume_session_id and trimmed_prefix metadata to token_ledger events and traces, (2) keep provisional visible only in a collapsed provisional bucket in console (default hidden), (3) runtime: hold ephemeral lease for 10s on the previous session id to allow reconnect using same id, (4) longer: run a reconcile job that de-duplicates confirmed vs provisional within 5 minutes and issues credits automatically.
Ajay: implementation notes: resume_session_id is straightforward to surface from the runtime if we plumb the resume token into the billing call. The reconcile job needs to be idempotent and timebounded. We also need a schema migration for ledger events (add resume_session_id string field) — telemetry pipeline will need to accept the new tag.
Kai: caveat: clients don't always send a resume token. If they don't, holding a lease on the old session id helps only for well-behaved clients. For others we should rely on reconcile rules based on token ranges and overlap windows.
Sam: any quick code pointer? Ajay — can you add a small patch to biller to include "parent_session" when present and to tag provisional vs confirmed?
Ajay: yes. I'll open a tiny PR that adds parent_session and trimmed_prefix tags to the ledger event. Also will add a flag to console to hide provisional by default. PR will include tests for dedupe logic when parent_session present.
Maria: UX note: make the console explain what provisional means and include a link to docs. Also add a filter to see provisional charges only.
Sam: ops ask: can we add a Kibana/trace link in the billing row? That would make oncall triage easier.
Kai: easy — include trace_id in ledger rows. Ops can jump to traces.
Ajay: ETA: I'll ship PR for ledger tags + trace_id today, reconcile job spike next week. Will handle console hide/provisional as separate PR.
Maria: I'll own the docs + console copy.
Sam: Perfect. Follow-up: can we add a short alert on errant duplicate billing rate >0.5% in the provisional window? ops-bot to notify if threshold crossed.
deploy-bot: deploy/prod succeeded: infra/billing 2026-03-19T12:35:00Z
Ajay: putting task in eng-platform board: BILL-742 add resume/parent session tags + reconcile job.
Maria: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and add the refund note to the ticket.
